- **B page**: the two-plane primitive one-form example `*u = −iu`, `u∧*ū = 2e∧f`.

- **AC**: stated on the four A items that consume AC-stated suppliers; the Hodge–Riemann item additionally declares the AC ⇒ AC_ω chain item for Stokes; the splitting lemma and B example are choice-free and say so.
- One genuine slip caught in final review (a star-formula exponent on a consumer of primitivity, which would have contradicted the item's own positivity clause) was fixed and the item re-recorded; three wording fixes likewise.
